The '''Battle of Sullust''' was a conflict during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Captive" /> The criminal [[Nok Drayen]] betrayed the Republic forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to the Empire,<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> resulting in the capture of the legendary [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ako Domi]] as well as other Republic soldiers, with the captives being imprisoned in the prison district of [[Shadow Town]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Captive" /> Years after the battle, [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] were still coming to reap the spoils.<ref name="SCV" />
